description: For an agent that thinks with this app: makes a key that can only run this one agent's checks and gives the commands that install them on this computer (a script in ~/.aindex and a crontab line). Show the person what will be installed and ask before running it; it needs to run outside any sandbox. The key goes straight from AINDEX to a file here, never into this chat. Needs this chat connected with Run my agents.
name: schedule_checks
title: Set up an agent's checks on this computer
